entities.summary: Russian Revolution, a transformative movement in Kazakhstan (1917–1934). Emerged from Alash Orda declares Kazakh autonomy during the Russian Civil War. Catalyzed Collectivization famine (Asharshylyk) kills approximately 1.5 million Kazakhs and Industrialization and Nuclear Testing.
